usage_notes.styling: Use sx prop for styling, which provides access to theme-aware CSS utilities
usage_notes.date_pickers: For Calendar and DatePicker, consider @mui/x-date-pickers package
usage_notes.rich_text: For RichTextBox, consider third-party libraries like react-quill or draft-js
